Aliah University Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Aliah University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for Aliah University Recruitment 2026 is Visiting Faculty. This is a contractual position offered by the university.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Visiting Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are 0 vacancies announced for the Visiting Faculty post in Aliah University Recruitment 2026. Candidates are encouraged to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for Aliah University Visiting Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Aliah University Visiting Faculty Recruitment is scheduled for 21 September 2026. Candidates should arrive at the venue well before the reporting time.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Visiting Faculty position?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Visiting Faculty position are as per UGC guidelines. Specific details regarding qualifications can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Visiting Faculty post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Visiting Faculty post is offered on a per class basis with a ceiling per month. Detailed salary structure is available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Extra passport-size photographs are also recommended.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue for the walk-in interview is Aliah University, Kolkata, West Bengal, 700014. Please refer to the official notification for the exact reporting time and specific location within the university.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Visiting Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Visiting Faculty role will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.
